title: LA MALÉDICTION DE MANGO — ÉPISODE 1
description: Mango vend le meilleur jus du marché Dokoti… et sa propre tante ne le supporte plus. Cette nuit, au couvent d'Oncle Piment, elle passe commande. 🥭🌶️ Épisode 1 — à suivre ! #LaMalédictionDeMango #FruitsAfricains #FeuilletonAfricain #Yetna #DramaIA
lieu: Yetna, a fictional African village inspired by Cameroon, Ivory Coast and Benin: earthen and cement houses with corrugated metal roofs, dusty paths, banana trees and tropical trees. Every building, road and stall keeps the same place in every shot.

lieux.marche: Dokoti market, Yetna, daytime: big open-air African market, dusty central alley with uneven stones, wooden shops, baskets, basins, fruit stalls, fabric awnings, banana trees and modest houses behind. Mango's wooden juice kiosk on one side of the alley (counter, green and white tarp roof, juice bottles, clear glasses, fresh mangoes, sign MANGO above). Tante Mango's smaller stall on the other side of the alley, set back, facing the kiosk.
lieux.marche_soir: The same Dokoti market at dusk: traders closing their stalls, customers leaving, violet and dark blue sky, a few warm lights under the awnings. Same layout: Mango's kiosk on one side of the alley, Tante Mango's stall across, set back.
lieux.foret: Yetna's mystic forest at night: dense dark tropical forest, tall twisted trunks framing a narrow path, branches forming a vault, exposed roots, lianas, dead leaves, low bluish mist, moonlight barely piercing the foliage; mostly blue and green light.
lieux.couvent: Oncle Piment's convent: a clearing at the heart of the forest at night. An ancient mossy stone altar covered with roots in the centre; on it a large calabash full of glowing green liquid with slow green smoke rising. Candles, wooden objects, small calabashes and ritual accessories around the altar, always at the same places.
lieux.chambre: Mango's bedroom in Yetna at night: earth-coloured walls, wooden bed with a woven surface, thin mattress, light pillow, beige blanket, an open window letting in bluish night light, a light curtain moving gently, a small wooden bedside table with a juice bottle and a few personal objects.

characters.name: Mango
characters.appearance: Young mango man, about 23. round ripe mango head in yellow-green, orange and red shades, small brown stem and one green leaf on top, warm brown face with brown eyes, thick black eyebrows, wide warm smile and a short black goatee. Slim athletic brown body. Short-sleeved yellow wax shirt with red and blue circular patterns, brown trousers rolled at the ankle, brown leather sandals, brown leather shoulder bag across the chest, beaded bracelets on the right wrist, black watch on the left wrist.
characters.voice: Young African man, warm and energetic voice with Cameroonian or Ivorian intonation; loud, joking and smiling when he sells; trembling and panicked when he suffers.

characters.name: Tante Mango
characters.appearance: Mango woman, about 52, Mango's aunt. Round ripe mango head in green-yellow and orange shades, stern displeased face with thick eyebrows, dark eyes, full cheeks, gold hoop earrings and a gold pendant necklace. Stout authoritative posture, often arms crossed. purple head wrap with gold patterns, purple blouse with gold embroidery, long purple and gold wrap pagne with diamond patterns, gold bangles, brown sandals.
characters.voice: Mature African woman, deep, authoritative and expressive voice; sighs, tongue clicks (tchip), sarcastic remarks; goes from a scornful murmur to an angry shout.

characters.detail: purple and gold head wrap and gold hoop earrings

characters.name: Oncle Piment
characters.appearance: Old anthropomorphic dried red chili pepper, village sorcerer. Wrinkled cracked dark red chili head with a long curled brown stem on top, gaunt skull-like face, glowing yellow eyes, wide toothy menacing grin, wispy grey beard. Extremely thin, hunched, long bony red arms and fingers. Tattered rust-brown robe and shawl, many bead necklaces, belt of cowrie shells with a small gourd and bells, brown sandals. Holds a tall twisted carved wooden staff decorated with cowries and a red tassel.
characters.voice: Very old man, deep, hoarse and sometimes grating voice, theatrical and mocking; his signature laugh « Kèh kèh kèh ! » always sounds the same.

Premium 3D animation, 9:16.

characters.name: Citron

Bright yellow lemon head with subtle peel texture, small brown stem and one green leaf on top, stylised African male features, expressive eyes, thick eyebrows, short dark goatee, confident half-smile. Slim brown body. Short-sleeved cream wax shirt with yellow, orange and black square patterns, brown trousers rolled at the ankle, dark brown sandals, beaded bracelets on both wrists.
